scheme_name: Subsidy for the Purchase of Wooden/Fiber Reinforced Plastic/Steel Mechanised Boats
other_conditions: Applicant must have resided in the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least five continuous years before applying
Applicant must be enrolled as a member of the Fishermen Co-operative Society
Applicant must not have received Old Age Pension from the department
Applicant must not be employed in any Government, Government Undertaking, or Fishermen Co-operative Society
Applicant must have no outstanding dues to the Department or Fishermen Co-operative Societies
Male applicants must have a minimum of five years sea‑fishing experience in a mechanized boat
Female applicants must have sufficient fishing‑trade experience
Entrepreneur applicants must have fishing‑trade experience
benefits_summary: Provides up to 50% subsidy on purchase or modernization of mechanized fishing boats, with maximum caps ranging from ₹2,50,000 to ₹11,00,000 depending on boat type and size.
